Which deadlines are coming up in October?

response.text:
Here are the deadlines in October 2026, soonest first. Payments and appointments are in the second list.

**Deadlines**
- Return the overdue library items, due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Fees keep growing until then. You can also renew online if the items aren't reserved.
- Optional objection to the Muster BKK contribution notice, due Wed 14 Oct 2026, with send-by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. After that date the notice becomes final. An objection does not suspend payment.
- Cancel the appointment at the Ausländerbehörde if you can't attend, due Mon 19 Oct 2026, with send-by Tue 13 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- Cancel the FunkNetz Smart M mobile contract, which must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026, with send-by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. The current term ends on Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- Special cancellation of the MusterStrom Flex electricity contract because of a price rise on 1 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5]. The cancellation must arrive by Sat 31 Oct 2026, and the send-by date is Mon 26 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5]. Then the new price never applies.

**Payments and appointments in October**
- Parking warning fee, due Fri 2 Oct 2026: 30.00 € [item:itm_31yxpwg03cdb]. The amount was read by AI from a scan, so please check it against the paper letter.
- Monthly rent, due Mon 5 Oct 2026: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Dental check-up at 09:15 on Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tt8cexs1k1tw].
- Additional operating costs, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Residence permit extension appointment at 10:30 on Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. The 100.00 € fee is due the same day, by girocard [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- Electricity advance payment by direct debit, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w].
- Health and care insurance contribution by direct debit, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].

The library return and the parking fee are both due on 2 Oct, and their send-by dates come first. You can mark items done or draft letters in Ordnung.
